pictures.name: SW1-Frontier-Farm
pictures.prompt: Ancient China, Han dynasty, a small farmhouse of earth and timber on the windswept northern frontier, wide grassland and far hills behind. A white-bearded old farmer in a plain brown hemp robe stands by a wooden fence with his young adult son, who wears a blue tunic; three horses graze nearby. Late afternoon gold light, long shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
